answer_1.quote: We evaluated our proposed tree-based evaluation metric against three existing metrics—BLEU, ROUGE-L, and BERT-Score—on sewing instructions generated via a range of prompting strategies.
datasets: Sewing pattern dataset (22 patterns spanning five garment types)

answer_2.quote: We evaluated our proposed tree-based evaluation metric against three existing metrics—BLEU, ROUGE-L, and BERT-Score—on a set of sewing instructions.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 20 participants with experience in sewing garments to rate the model-generated instructions... All human evaluations were conducted on the LingoTurk platform.
answer_4.guideline: Participants answered five step-level questions (S1–S5) and two instruction-level questions (I1–I2) on a 5-point Likert scale for each instruction set.
criteria: S1: step makes sense with regard to the picture
S2: step makes sense with regard to the pattern piece descriptions
S3: step makes sense with regard to the previous step
S4: step is clear enough to follow
S5: terminology in the step is used correctly
I1: overall possibility to assemble the pieces following the instructions
I2: assembly steps lead to the correct final garment
